ratings_why.fun: Watching passports fill and fish spawn, come home and go again is a real arc to draft towards, though Leap order and Stamps ask a lot of attention per card.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7: Leaps swap the unit they pass, so the bank folk slide down and one Landlady catches a whole column; no tribe today has that bank-versus-river plumbing.

verdict_why: The v1 readability problems are fixed in text and rulings; what remains is UI work (stamp pips, the river drawn), not a card fix.

points.text: Leaps in the recruit phase that the player can drag back read as movement but only count as a Stamp; End of Turn Leaps like Tail-Sweep Hen's are where recruit movement really matters, so lean the tribe's recruit Leaps that way.
Bear at the Long Leap's "Once a turn, fight included" reads stiffly; "Once a turn, recruiting or fighting" says the same thing at a glance.
Old Bradán is the densest card in the tribe; showing the Spawn texts he holds on his card, as the risks say, is what makes him readable.
The Bailiff's lore is stamping passports, but his card only gives stats; giving a front-row arrival an extra Stamp would make the heron do what he is known for.
The Salmon of Llyn Llyw carried Arthur's men; its double-Stamp text doesn't show that, where carrying another fish upstream with it would.

standouts.why: The Landlady reads instantly and the swap rule makes one pub buff a whole column of pilgrims.
The Bear forces a Spawn and takes half the fish: the hunted narrows of the river, in one card.
The Alder grows from spent fish, the real sea-nitrogen story, and stays put as a carry.

weakest.why: Uncle Faroe is a Stamp and 3 gold; the boasting emigrant doesn't come through in what he does.
Spate-Rider is a generic death chain; the flood fantasy is thin next to the rest.
Llyn Llyw is a pure number multiplier with little of its legend in the text.

flags.note: With Old Kelt and Llyn Llyw, Weir-Jumper's Fry deaths refill its passport mid-fight and each lap adds three Fry and feeds the Alder; bounded by board space and enemy attacks.
Mother Redd with the Bear and Llyn Llyw can make a triple and a Discover every turn or two late on.
